Record date: 2009-04-07. MR: 5247840. Name : Mark Villegas- 58-yr-old male.  Mr. Mark Villegas is seen today at Duke University Hospital.  I have not seen him since 23 November. March 14th,  Mark Villegas stopped his Prednisone on his own because he was gaining weight.  Mr. Mark Villegas does feel that his shoulders are definitely improved. On examination 04/07/2009, BP 120/80.  His joint examination is much improved with better ROM of the shoulders and no peripheral joint synovitis.  Clinical Impression: 1:  Inflammatory arthritis - possibly RA - with response noted to Hydroxychloroquine along with Prednisone.  He has stopped the Prednisone, and I would not restart it yet.  2:  New onset of symptoms suspicious for right-sided carotid disease.  Will arrange for carotid ultrasound studies.  I advised Mark Villegas to call me if he experiences worsening symptoms. MSW 1543681632582<br>Sanjay Gupta, M.D. Duke University Hospital 26545 Oak Street . DD: 04/07/2009 . DT: 04/15/2009 .
